name: GET My Ride
note: Main service in Elko, Spring Creek, Osino; limited service to Carlin and Wells. Ryndon not resolvable in gazetteer. Veterans medical-only trips available countywide but treated as secondary to primary service area.

name: Lake Link (Nevada service area)
note: Douglas County service area covering Round Hill, Lower Kingsbury, Zephyr Cove, Stateline casino corridor. Nevada portion of bi-state Lake Link service (CA row exists separately). Lower Kingsbury treated as part of broader Round Hill/Zephyr Cove cluster.

name: RTC OnDemand
note: Approx. 32–33 sq mi zone spanning Southwest Las Vegas Valley and West Henderson, Clark County (RTC OnDemand, https://www.rtcsnv.com/rtcondemand/). Circle centered on CSV pin (36.0272, -115.1147) with radius from stated area (32.5 sq mi → r≈5.17 km); not clipped to city limits since the zone straddles the Las Vegas/Henderson boundary. Service area has expanded multiple times since 2021 launch; current boundary approximated.

name: RTC Washoe FlexRIDE On-Demand Service
note: Service zones include North Valleys, Sparks/Spanish Springs, South Meadows, Verdi/Somersett. Specify main incorporated centers (Reno, Sparks); unincorporated zones approximated within these bounds.
